none: PAS NLM-A99051: Roman Coin: Denarius of Trajan
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver coin. Denarius of Trajan (98-117), cf Sear vol. 2 no. 3158 citing RIC vol. 2 no. 161, mint of Rome issue of 107, but bust here is not draped; RIC vol. 2 no. 162 is similar but no aegis on obverse; these given as issue of 103-104. Suggested issue of 103-107. Obverse description: Bust laureate right, elongated neck to throat. Obverse inscription: [--]GER DAC[---]. Reverse description: Soldier standing facing with vertical spear and shield resting on ground. Reverse inscription: [--]O[-]III. Diameter: 18.3mm, Weight: 2.23gms, die axis: 6
